idea.problem: AI-assisted implementation loses the evidence, uncertainty, dissent, and human authorization behind code changes. Nothing connects a shipped change back to the reasoning and the approval boundary that authorized it.
idea.proposed_direction: Add a repository-local, versioned Decision Ledger and a guarded Claude Code handoff generator to the Omnarai MCP server, unified with the repository's existing proposals/ convention (OMN-P numbering).
idea.intended_outcome: An approved implementation task carries its lineage — sources, uncertainty, dissent, approval, verification — from idea to code, inspectable via Git diffs and MCP tools.

uncertainties: File-backed approval is an auditable attestation recorded in Git, not verified identity; do not describe it as strong authorization.
The repository lives in iCloud Drive: sync conflict copies and file eviction can undermine atomic-rename assumptions for the ledger.
Adoption policy (which changes require a record) is deferred to later phases.

dissent.claim: A decision ledger could become burdensome process overhead for small changes.
dissent.response: Phase 1 is deliberately limited: three tools, opt-in via OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR, no workflow mandates.

dissent.claim: Shipping local-write tools in a published npm package changes its read-only trust posture.
dissent.response: Resolved by gating: decision tools are hidden unless OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR is explicitly set, so a bare npx install stays read-only.

proposal.decision: Implement Phase 1 of the provenance-to-shipping workflow inside omnarai-mcp: schema, store, state machine, handoff gate, three opt-in MCP tools, tool/version parity enforcement, tests, and documentation — adapted to the repository as it actually is (7 tools, structuredContent convention, node --test, versions already at 1.5.0, remote MCP already live).
scope: lib/decision-schema.js — runtime-validated Decision Record schema (schema_version 1) persisted as JSON.

lib/decision-store.js — ledger store confined to OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR: server-generated OMN-P ids continuing the existing numbering, exclusive creates, atomic replacement writes, validation on every read and write.
lib/decision-state.js — legal transitions, guards, revision policy: a material edit after approval invalidates the approval.
lib/decision-handoff.js — deterministic Claude Code packet from an approved record at its approved revision only.
lib/decision-tools.js + index.js wiring — omnarai_create_decision_record, omnarai_get_decision_lineage, omnarai_prepare_claude_code_handoff; advertised only when OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR is set.
lib/tool-definitions.js — canonical tool schemas; scripts/check-tool-parity.js enforces openai-tools.json parity and version agreement; wired into scripts/publish.sh.
index.js reads its version from package.json at startup (removes the drift mechanism that shipped 1.3.0 telemetry inside the 1.4.0 package).
openai-tools.json gains the omnarai_context layers/exclude/evidence_threshold properties it was missing.
Tests under test/ (node --test, mkdtemp, no network) and README documentation.
non_goals: MCP tools that approve, transition status, verify, or ship records — approval and shipping remain explicit human actions recorded in Git.
Automated Git, PR, merge, deployment, or publishing actions; no credential handling of any kind.
Exposing the decision tools on the remote /api/mcp endpoint (see OMN-P-044).
Cloud database, dashboard, or identity/SSO integration.
acceptance_criteria: An unapproved or stale-approved record cannot generate a Claude Code handoff.
Handoffs deterministically contain scope, non-goals, acceptance criteria, uncertainty, dissent, and verification requirements.
Storage cannot escape the configured ledger root; unsafe ids are rejected before touching the filesystem.
Corrupt or invalid records fail loud on read; creates are exclusive; updates are atomic replacements.
MCP and openai-tools.json surfaces agree on names, required fields, and property names; decision tools are provably local-only.
Runtime version, package.json, and server.json cannot silently disagree.
A bare npx omnarai-mcp (no OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR) advertises only the seven read-only engine tools.
verification_plan: node --check on every changed JS file.
npm test (node --test): schema, store, state, handoff-gate, parity, and existing inquiry-brief suites.
node scripts/check-tool-parity.js as a standalone gate.
stdio smoke test: tools/list shows 7 tools without OMNARAI_DECISIONS_DIR and 10 with it; handoff call on this unapproved-at-creation record fails closed.

Chat approval is an attestation recorded here, not a verified identity.
